required_checks: Lint,Typecheck,Test,Validate manifests,Parse tickets,Build,ActiveGraph gate,Playwright UI gate,Design contract,Plain English,Tickets match the history,Provision scripts
description: Ordinary project checks only. Configure real commands. Runtime environment and scenarios are separate inputs. required_checks names the CI checks a merge needs (comma-separated, or "none"); the merge queue reads it where GitHub cannot report branch protection, as on free private repositories. protected_paths lists root-anchored path patterns (* within a segment, ** across segments) that only a human may change; the merge queue holds any pull request that touches one.
